tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "A4247AAB4F8A16AF2C2D5FAF765880CA", "You\'ve entered your first Settlement! Each is a seed of great potential, a wilderness that can grow into a mighty metropolis.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "4419F2624A4C6318BF1A759432E3E8E2", "Once a Settlement has begun to grow, it offers services to those working to tame its wilds and help its settlers.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "04ED038E46B5E5788BB08FAE7FD371D1", "Your actions can help a Settlement grow into a city where you can put down roots and become a citizen. Citizens can play a more active role in deciding how a Settlement will develop.")
